# Leboncoin.fr Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/leboncoin-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/leboncoin-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property data from leboncoin.fr, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Web Scrape Leboncoin.fr using Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-leboncoin-marketplace-real-estate)
- **Code:** [`leboncoin.py`](leboncoin.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Ad pages](results/ads.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Leboncoin search for finding ad listings
- Leboncoin ad pages for ads data

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url, scrape_all_pages, max_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape leboncoin search
- `scrape_ad(url, _retries=0)` → `Dict`: scrape ad page

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import leboncoin


async def main():
    search = await leboncoin.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.leboncoin.fr/recherche?text=coffe",
        max_pages=2,
        scrape_all_pages=False,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/ads.json`](results/ads.json): `list_id`, `first_publication_date`, `expiration_date`, `index_date`, `status`, `category_id`, `category_name`, `subject`, `body`, `brand`, `ad_type`, `url`, `price`, `price_cents`, `images`, `attributes`, `location`, `owner`, `options`, `has_phone`, `attributes_listing`, `similar`, `counters`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `list_id`, `first_publication_date`, `index_date`, `status`, `category_id`, `category_name`, `subject`, `body`, `brand`, `ad_type`, `url`, `price`, `price_cents`, `images`, `attributes`, `location`, `owner`, `options`, `has_phone`, `similar`, `counters`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`leboncoin.py`](leboncoin.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"fr"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/leboncoin-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_search_scraping`, `test_ad_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
